name: default_milestones
description: Default checkpoint list used when a stage does not define its own checkpoints. These cover the early-game story beats of Pokemon Red (Pallet Town through Route 1).

checkpoints.name: Party Has Starter
checkpoints.description: Party contains at least one Pokemon

checkpoints.name: Fought Rival
checkpoints.description: Enter the initial rival battle with Professor Oak's lab

checkpoints.name: Won Rival Battle
checkpoints.description: Win your first trainer battle against the rival

checkpoints.name: Got Oak's Parcel
checkpoints.description: Obtain the Oak's Parcel from the guard on Route 1

checkpoints.name: ITEM: Oak Parcel
checkpoints.description: Have Oak's Parcel (item id 70) in your bag

checkpoints.name: Oak's Lab to give back parcel
checkpoints.description: Enter Oak's Lab (map id 40) while holding Oak's Parcel (item id 70) to deliver it

checkpoints.name: Oak Got Parcel
checkpoints.description: Deliver Oak's Parcel to Professor Oak in Pallet Lab

checkpoints.name: Parcel Delivered
checkpoints.description: Deliver Oak's Parcel to Professor Oak in Pallet Lab

checkpoints.name: Get More Pokeballs
checkpoints.description: Obtain additional Pokeballs after delivering the Parcel (player starts with 5)

checkpoints.name: Healed Pokemon at Pokemon Center
checkpoints.description: Enter a Pokemon Center (Viridian City interior, map 0x5D) and heal

checkpoints.name: Go Through Viridian Forest
checkpoints.description: Defeat a trainer inside Viridian Forest (map 0x03)

checkpoints.name: Go to Pokemon Center in Pewter City
checkpoints.description: Enter the Pewter City Pokemon Center (map 0x5F)

checkpoints.name: Get First Badge
checkpoints.description: Defeat Brock and obtain the Cascade Badge
